findings.message: The starter workflow omits a cost warning for automatic model-backed generation on push.
findings.rationale: The example runs on every push to `main` and passes `OPENAI_API_KEY` into `docstube/action@v0`. A maintainer copying this as the “common starting point” could trigger paid model usage on every matching push without the page warning them to scope triggers or protect the secret.
